info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create External Agency Product Broker Agreement-spec
info.description: The External Agency Product Broker Agreement Management API facilitates the creation and management of broker agreements for external agencies within the banking domain. This API enables users to initiate agreements that define the terms and conditions between banking institutions and external agency partners. Typical consumers include banking administrators and compliance officers who need to streamline and standardize agreement processing. The API supports essential operations for overseeing the lifecycle of such agreements, ensuring effective collaboration and regulatory adherence.

post.summary: Create a new Product Broker Agreement for an external agency.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a Product Broker Agreement associated with an external agency, enabling seamless collaboration and agreement management.
